verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same. Both stack a cropped blue image strip, the '&' with 'Baby Toddler', and 'BEDDING' in one vertical column. In both, the strip floats with an odd skewed edge, the dot grids crowd the Baby/Toddler lockup on the right, and there is dead space on the left. A gives BEDDING a more comfortable bottom margin and keeps the image strip a bit larger. B makes BEDDING slightly bigger, but pushes it close to the bottom edge, so the bottom feels cramped and the image strip shrinks.
